disclaimer.title: Food Recall Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
This application provides food recall information for products sold in the United States for informational purposes only.

The information displayed in this app is based on publicly available data from government agencies (including but not limited to the FDA and USDA) and other third-party sources. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the information provided.

This app does not replace official recall notifications, manufacturer communications, or guidance from regulatory authorities. Users are encouraged to verify recall information directly with official sources.

A product not identified as recalled in this app does not guarantee that the product is safe or not subject to a current or future recall.

This app does not provide medical, nutritional, or health advice. If you have concerns about food safety, contamination, allergies, or illness, consult a qualified healthcare professional or follow official guidance from public health authorities.

This app does not verify expiration dates or product freshness.

Barcode scanning, lot number recognition, and voice or visual outputs may be subject to technical limitations or errors. Users remain responsible for verifying product details and recall status.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer shall not be liable for any direct or indirect damages, injuries, or losses arising from the use or reliance on the information provided by this app.

Recall coverage is limited to food products sold in the United States and may not apply to products sold in other countries.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.voiceGuideDescription: Enables voice announcements and voice commands during scanning. Useful for low-vision users or hands-free use on tablets.
accessibility.voiceTestMessage: Voice guidance is enabled. You will hear announcements during scanning.

voice.scanBarcodeReady: Barcode mode. Place the product about eight inches in front of the phone, with the barcode facing the camera. It scans on its own.
voice.barcodeCoach1: Still looking for the barcode. Keep the product about eight inches in front of the phone, barcode facing the camera.
voice.barcodeCoach2: Slowly move the product a little nearer or farther until I find the barcode.
voice.barcodeCoach3: Turn the product to show the barcode to the camera. It scans on its own.
voice.barcodeGiveUp: I still can't find a barcode. Switching to scanning the lot number.
voice.productFound: Product found: {{brand}}. Now scan the lot number.
voice.productNotFound: Product not found. Switching to the lot number scan.
voice.lotKeepSteady: No lot number yet. Keep the phone steady on the lot number.
voice.scanLotReady: Lot number mode. Hold your phone about eight inches from the product. Capture is automatic, turn the product slowly.
voice.scanLotTip: Turn the product slowly in front of the camera. The lot number is often near an edge, the lid, or under the packaging.
voice.lotInFrame: I think I see a lot number. Hold still, I'm reading it.
voice.blur: Hold the product very still for a moment.
voice.tooFar: Move the product closer to the camera.
voice.tooClose: Move the product a little farther from the camera.
voice.lowLight: Low light. Move the product toward a light source.
voice.lotDetected: I think I found the lot number: {{lot}}.
voice.lotNotDetected: I couldn't read the lot number. Double-tap the screen to type it in yourself.
voice.lotCoach1a: Still looking for the lot number. Turn the product slowly.
voice.lotCoach1b: Move the product gently in front of the camera, I'm still reading.
voice.lotCoach1c: Still searching, take your time. Move the product a little closer or farther.
voice.lotCoach2a: Look for the small print near the lid or cap, and show it to the camera.
voice.lotCoach2b: The lot number is often under the packaging or near an edge. Turn the product to show it.
voice.lotCoach2c: Slowly rotate the product, a quarter turn at a time, facing the camera.
voice.lotCoach3a: Hold the product still for two seconds, facing the camera.
voice.lotCoach3b: Steady the product at chest height, facing the camera, without moving.
voice.lotCoach3c: One more try. Look for the line of letters and numbers, often near the date.
voice.lotGiveUpSoon: I can't read the lot number. If you like, double-tap the screen to type it in yourself.
voice.lotPartialSeen: I can see a code but not all of it. Show the whole code and turn the product slowly.
voice.recallDetected: Warning. This product is subject to a recall. Do not consume.
voice.productSafe: No recall found for this product.
